# November 7 - Researched on components and wired the schematic
## What did I do this session?
This session I started by doing some research on my Mini GameConsole. I found the display, sound producer, buttons, and more.
After that I started the schematic and placed out the components needed aswell as importing the thumbwheel potentiometer that I am going to use to controll the sound volume.
